The Kubernetes application was failing to rollout because the pods were stuck in `Pending` state due to `Insufficient cpu` resources on the available nodes. I inspected the failing pod and determined the resource requests were too high. I patched the deployment to reduce the CPU request for the container from `100m` to `50m`. The rollout subsequently completed successfully and the application is now healthy.
